title: App Store reviews
description: iTunes customer reviews for a list of App Store ids, read from the public lookup and customer-reviews RSS feeds. No proxy, CAPTCHA solver, or browser is used. A non-empty Play package list is not fetched: the run pushes one blocked row and stops.

appStoreIds.title: App Store ids
appStoreIds.description: iTunes numeric app ids. A store URL containing id=NNNN or /idNNNN is accepted and reduced to the number. Facebook for iOS is 284882215.

playIds.title: Google Play packages
playIds.description: Google Play package names, such as com.facebook.katana. Play is deferred: when this list is non-empty the Actor pushes one blocked row after the App Store apps and does not call Play. Leave it empty.

country.title: Storefront
country.description: Two-letter iTunes storefront. Lowercased before use. us is the United States.

since.title: Since date
since.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD. Reviews whose calendar date is older than this are dropped. The date is the review's own offset, or the UTC date when the timestamp has no offset.

maxItems.title: Max reviews
maxItems.description: Hard cap on successful review rows after the since filter and dedupe. Status rows do not count and are not billed.

sentiment.title: Sentiment add-on
sentiment.description: When on, each pushed review also gets a local lexicon sentiment label and score. No network and no model API. Charged as a separate sentiment event.

delaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
delaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait before each request after the first. Requests run one at a time. The pause jitters upward by up to 1 second.

maxSpendUsd.title: Max spend (USD)
maxSpendUsd.description: A review is pushed only when its review charge, and the sentiment charge when that add-on is on, both fit under this amount. When the next review would pass it, the feed stops and one free spend_capped row records how many reviews were held back. Default 5, minimum 0.01, maximum 100.
